definitions.explanation: A thin-bladed saw used for cutting intricate curves and shapes in wood or other materials.

examples.japanese: {糸鋸|いとのこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{曲線|きょくせん}→曲線：05441_kyokusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: Cut curves with a coping saw.

examples.japanese: {糸鋸|いとのこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a wooden doll using a fretsaw.

examples.japanese: {糸鋸|いとのこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Replace the blade on the coping saw.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧ (thread) + {鋸|のこ} (saw). Named for its thin, thread-like blade.

TYPES:
- ⟦{手|て}{回|まわ}し→手回し：08127_temawashi⟧{糸鋸|いとのこ}: hand coping saw
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{糸鋸|いとのこ}: electric scroll saw
- ⟦{卓上|たくじょう}→卓上：22894_takujou⟧{糸鋸盤|いとのこばん}: bench-mounted scroll saw

FUNCTIONS:
- Cutting intricate shapes
- Making puzzles
- Craft projects
- Detailed woodworking
- Cutting internal shapes (blade can be threaded through a drilled hole)

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧: blade
- ⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧: frame
- ⟦{柄|え}→柄：01924_e⟧: handle

RELATED SAWS:
- のこぎり: general saw
- {弓鋸|ゆみのこ}: hacksaw
- {丸鋸|まるのこ}: circular saw
- ジグソー: jigsaw (power tool)

CLASSROOM USE: Common in Japanese ⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧ (arts and crafts) and ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (technology) classes.
